The Shared Prepare-Commit-Msg: the Gate Report Folded Into the Message Once, Every Failure Reported Rather Than Swallowed, and No Push
The Host Facts: the zram Ceiling and the Tick Lock Read as Facts, Absent When Unreadable and Never Zeros or Empty
The Tick-Stop Guard: a Held Fresh Host Lock Blocks the Stop Once and Never Twice, a Stale or Unreadable One Blocks Nothing
The Tick Gate: a Loop Prompt That Cannot Run Is Refused Before It Costs a Turn, Every Other Prompt Passes Untouched, and a Fact That Cannot Be Read Blocks Nothing

The After-Compaction Context: the Project's Pointers to Its Durable State and the Live Host Facts Come Back After a Compact Only, a Missing Notes File Is Said Not Skipped, and a Session Start Is Never Blocked

The Tick-Lock Release: a Fresh Host Lock Is Released at Session End Through the One Writer, a Stale or Unreadable One Is Left Alone, and a Writer That Cannot Be Found or Fails Is Said and the Lock Left Held
The Python Edit Gate by Hand: the Unclipped Verdict on One File, Not-Checked Is Never Clean, and a File in No Project Is Not Checked Though the Hook Would Admit It
The Gate's Verdict as a Ledger: Findings Counted per File From the Report's Own Markers, a Refusal Never Zero, and a File No Checker Judged Never Clean

The Build-Failure Report: a Failed Build's Cause Read From BuildBuddy by Invocation Id and Fed Back on Exit 2, an Unreadable Log or Missing Reader Stated With the Command, and a Failure That Ran No Build Left Alone
The Closure Advisory: Unclean Imports Named From Debtplan's Graph With Their Findings, and Silence When No Ledger, Planner or Debt Is There
The Closure Hook: an Edited Python File's Unclean Imports Added as Context After the Edit, Never a Refusal, and Anything Else Says Nothing
The Gate's Verdict on Every Changed File: Names From Git's Status, a Rename's Origin and a Deletion Skipped, and One Exit That a Refusal Never Loses to a Clean Run
The Commit Kata: a Commit's Outcome Read From HEAD and Stated in One Last Line (Committed, Refused, or Not Committed), No Tracked Path Committing Nothing, and a Rewritten Lock Riding Along
The Hooks Preflight: the Venv Rebuilt Before the Changed-Files Verdict, and a Rebuild That Cannot Run Is Not Checked, Never Clean
The Read Guard: an Unbounded Whole-File Read of an Oversized File Is Denied With the Cheaper Reads Named, a Bounded or Rendered or Unsizable One Is Admitted, and an Unarmed Guard Says Nothing
The Bazel Admission: Heavy Commands Wait on Zram Headroom and a Memory Lease, Light Ones Run Untouched, a Full Zram Is Refused After a Bounded Wait, and What Cannot Be Read Blocks Nothing
The Format Mode: The Project's Own Formatter Applied to One File, Written Only When It Changes, and a File in No Project Never Reads as Clean
The Snapshot: An Immutable Tree at One Fixed Namespaced Path, Locked Against a Second Writer, Updated by Its Difference, and Never the Real Index
The Prune Cross-Check: What --prune Would Drop Must Equal the Pairing Check's Orphan Set, a Disagreement or a Missing Checker Refuses Before Anything Is Written, and --dry-run Shows It
The Section Agreement in the Pairing Check: Warrant Sections Against Rubric Rows, Named Both Ways, a Lost Tab or Title Caught Before Commit
The Commit Launcher: A Stable Path to mikemol-commit That Hands Every Argument Through and Refuses, Naming the Repair, When the Built Venv or Its Script Is Absent
